title: Pixels2Actions
hook: Can AI make up *practice worlds* for robots?
cta: Why AI-made worlds matter for robots: full episode, link below

beats.narration: Pilots learn in flight simulators, a safe place to practice before the real thing. So can an AI make up practice worlds like that for robots?
Google showed a new AI that creates a world as you move through it, like a video game with no game engine.
People walk around with the keyboard, and change the scene by typing what they want.
None of this is real. That robot arm, and this humanoid playing checkers, were made up by the AI too.

visual.credit: Video still: Google DeepMind · Generated by Genie 4

beats.narration: Google says it can help with building training environments for robots.
But it's an early preview, and Google doesn't say any robot has actually trained in it yet.
Why AI-made worlds matter for robots is in the full episode. Link below.
